verses.text: When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
lines: When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion,
we were like those who dream.

verses.text: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “Yahweh has done great things for them.”
lines: Then our mouth was filled with laughter,
Then they said among the nations,
“Yahweh has done great things for them.”

verses.text: Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.
lines: Yahweh has done great things for us,

verses.text: Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh, like the streams in the Negev.
lines: like the streams in the Negev.

verses.text: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
lines: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

verses.text: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
lines: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing,
will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
